text: OVERDOSAGE In the event of overdosage, discontinue infusion containing potassium acetate immediately and institute corrective therapy as indicated to reduce elevated serum potassium levels and restore acid-base balance if necessary. See WARNINGS , PRECAUTIONS , and ADVERSE REACTIONS .
